name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement

## Problem

Describe the problem this feature would solve. What can't you do today?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you'd like this to work. Include mockups if it's a UI change.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions you've thought about and why you discarded them.

## Additional context

Links, references, or examples from other products that do this well.
